info.name: ipify IP Geolocation Account IP Address API

params.name: format
params.description: Response encoding. Omit for plain text. `json` for a JSON object. `jsonp` for a JSONP callback wrapper.

params.name: callback
params.description: Custom JSONP callback function name. Only meaningful when `format=jsonp`. Defaults to `callback` if omitted.

items.docs: Return the caller's public IP address. Without query parameters the response body is plain text containing the IP. With `format=json` the response is a JSON object. With `format=jsonp` the response is a JSONP callback wrapper.
